blurb: Guests see animals from around the world in natural habitats, chat with keepers, and can add memorable experiences and adventures to their day. The zoo includes areas like Paws On for children and offers special events such as Jazzoo and wedding expos. The zoo is open daily with some sections opening later and is handicap accessible with rentals available for wheelchairs and strollers.
